name: urban-tourism-flow-predictor
description: Spatio-temporal transit & tourism congestion predictor for San Francisco using XGBoost, TreeSHAP, GTFS, and a React geospatial dashboard.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:pipeline && npm run verify:ml && npm run verify:api
scripts.pipeline: python -c "from data_pipeline.db_storage import init_database; from data_pipeline.traffic_synthesizer import synthesize_historical_dataset; from data_pipeline.db_storage import save_hourly_metrics; init_database(); df = synthesize_historical_dataset(); save_hourly_metrics(df); print(f'Done: {len(df)} records saved.')"
